## Validation

- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files`
- [ ] `pytest -q`

## Engineering Rules

- [ ] New classes and new public methods/functions include tests
- [ ] User-facing classes/features are documented in `docs/`
- [ ] Python files are <= 200 lines (or explicitly listed in `.policy/max-lines-exceptions.txt`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated when applicable
